headline: Italian Trade Unions Hold Nationwide General Strike Against Budget Bill
summary: Italian labor unions CGIL and Cobas organized nationwide strikes and demonstrations in over 100 cities protesting the government's economic budget bill.
why: CGIL is one of Italy's largest trade union confederations, capable of mobilizing industrial action across public transit and commercial services.

impacts.name: Italy
impacts.why: Nationwide general strikes disrupt domestic transport and public service operations.
